user.title: Set up Vistoda
user.description: Choose a provider. Vistoda Apps installed through Supervisor are discovered and configured automatically; manual external bridges remain an advanced option.

data_description.provider: Install the matching Vistoda App for the simplest setup. Blink, EZVIZ and Ring keep separate provider sessions.

blink.title: Adopt the local Blink adapter
blink.description: Vistoda found Blink Live Bridge and will reuse its five existing live camera entities and authenticated Blink session. It will not create another login or duplicate cameras.

discovery_confirm.title: Connect discovered {provider} bridge
discovery_confirm.description: Vistoda discovered the private endpoint and device alias over mDNS. Confirm ownership with the dedicated bridge API token; vendor credentials are not requested here.

data_description.api_token: Dedicated high-entropy token configured in the discovered bridge. It is never broadcast over mDNS.

bridge.title: Connect Vistoda to the private bridge
bridge.description: These are bridge connection values, not vendor credentials. For EZVIZ, first enroll the account and device verification code in the EZVIZ Rust bridge. For Ring, the account and password are requested on the next screen.

data_description.url: Base HTTP or HTTPS URL reachable from Home Assistant, for example http://192.168.50.20:8787. Do not enter the Home Assistant, vendor-cloud or public Traefik URL.
data_description.api_token: Dedicated high-entropy token configured for this Rust bridge. Do not enter an EZVIZ verification code, Ring password or vendor token.
data_description.alias: Exact device alias configured in the bridge, for example entrance_door. Vistoda uses it to address the stream and snapshot.

ring_credentials.title: Enroll the Ring account
ring_credentials.description: Vistoda forwards these credentials once to your private Ring bridge over the configured connection. Home Assistant does not save them. Ring may then send an SMS code.

data_description.email: Email address used to sign in to the Ring app. Do not enter a Home Assistant user or bridge account.
data_description.password: Current password for that Ring account. It is sent once to the private bridge and is never persisted in the Home Assistant config entry.

otp.title: Verify the Ring SMS
otp.description: Enter the six-digit code from Ring within two minutes. The challenge is single-use: a wrong or expired code requires restarting enrollment.

data_description.code: Use only the newest SMS sent by Ring for this enrollment. This is not an EZVIZ device verification code or a bridge API token.

ezviz_credentials.title: Enroll the EZVIZ account
ezviz_credentials.description: Vistoda sends these credentials once to the private EZVIZ App. Home Assistant does not save them. EZVIZ may send a six-digit MFA code.

data_description.account: Email address or account name used by the EZVIZ app.
data_description.password: Current EZVIZ account password; it is not the device verification code.
data_description.api_region: Use eu unless the EZVIZ account belongs to another region.

ezviz_otp.title: Verify the EZVIZ account
ezviz_otp.description: Enter the newest six-digit MFA code sent by EZVIZ. The challenge is single-use.

data_description.code: This is the temporary account MFA code, not the device verification code.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {provider}
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again to the same account through the existing Vistoda app. Your Home Assistant devices, history, automations and connection settings are preserved. Home Assistant never stores the account password.

ring_device.title: Choose your Ring intercom
ring_device.description: These intercoms were verified with your Ring account. Choose the entrance to add; other available entrances will be offered next.

managed_device.title: Choose an intercom
managed_device.description: Choose a discovered Ring intercom. Remaining devices will be offered in a follow-up setup. Existing entries retain their identity.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Vistoda
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant reaches the private bridge. The vendor account session remains owned by the bridge and is not changed here.

data_description.url: New base URL reachable from Home Assistant, without credentials or an API path.
data_description.api_token: Dedicated API token currently configured by the private Rust bridge.
data_description.alias: Exact device alias currently configured in the bridge. Changing it may change which stream Vistoda requests.

error.no_intercoms: No Ring intercom was found in this account. Check the Ring app and retry.
error.no_routable_intercoms: No new intercom has a verified provider route. Existing devices are already configured; for additional devices, update the Vistoda Ring app and retry.
error.discovered_device_changed: The selected physical intercom no longer matches discovery. Check the Vistoda Ring app.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the bridge. Check its private address, port, service status and firewall access from Home Assistant.
error.cannot_connect_restart: Verification could not complete. Check the bridge connection and start a fresh enrollment.
error.invalid_url: Enter a base HTTP or HTTPS bridge URL without credentials or API paths.
error.invalid_bridge_auth: The bridge API token is invalid. Use the dedicated token configured in the Rust bridge.
error.invalid_auth: Ring rejected the account email or password.
error.ezviz_invalid_auth: EZVIZ rejected the account or password.
error.ezviz_invalid_otp_restart: EZVIZ rejected the MFA code. Start a fresh enrollment with the newest code.
error.invalid_otp_restart: Ring rejected the code. Start a fresh enrollment; the old single-use challenge was consumed.
error.enrollment_busy: Another enrollment is active on this bridge.
error.enrollment_expired: The enrollment expired or was consumed. Start again.
error.rate_limited: The bridge or Ring is rate limiting enrollment. Wait before trying again.

abort.reauth_successful: The account was reconnected. Your existing devices and history were preserved.
abort.discovered_device_changed: A discovered alias conflicts with an existing physical device. Check the Vistoda app device mapping before trying again.
abort.managed_app_adopted: The existing provider connection is now managed by its Vistoda App.
abort.already_configured: This bridge device is already configured in Vistoda.
abort.blink_not_loaded: Blink Live Bridge must be loaded before Vistoda can adopt it.
abort.local_adapter: The local Blink adapter follows Blink Live Bridge and has no remote connection settings.
abort.managed_app: This connection is managed automatically by its Vistoda App.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered Vistoda App is not reachable yet. Check that it is running.
abort.invalid_bridge_auth: The discovered Vistoda App supplied an invalid private credential.
abort.unsupported_provider: The discovered service is not a supported Vistoda provider.

init.title: Vistoda connection and backup
init.description: For backups, first add network storage with Media usage in Home Assistant Settings → System → Storage. Enter only its name, not a server address or filesystem path. Vistoda verifies the exact NFS or SMB mount before writing. Reconnect starts a new sign-in without replacing devices.

data_description.backup_storage: Default: vistoda_archives. Backup remains unavailable until this network storage is mounted and writable.
data_description.reconnect_account: Use the same vendor account. Its password is forwarded once and is not saved in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_storage_name: Use a storage name with letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; do not enter a path.
error.network_mount_missing: This storage is not mounted as writable NFS or SMB media storage. Add or reconnect it in Home Assistant storage settings.
error.network_mount_not_writable: Home Assistant cannot write to this network storage.
error.network_mount_low_space: Network storage needs at least 512 MiB free.

bridge_unavailable.title: Vistoda {provider} is unavailable
bridge_unavailable.description: Home Assistant cannot reach the private Vistoda {provider} bridge. Check the matching app status and logs, then reload this integration. Credentials and private addresses are intentionally omitted from this issue.

ezviz_binding_unavailable.title: Vistoda cannot verify the selected EZVIZ camera
ezviz_binding_unavailable.description: The app is reachable, but its camera identity is unavailable or no longer matches this Home Assistant entry. Update Vistoda EZVIZ first, restore the camera serial and channel assigned to this alias, then reload the integration. Vistoda blocks live media and camera operations until the binding matches.

ring_push_unavailable.title: Vistoda Ring push events are unavailable
ring_push_unavailable.description: The Ring bridge is reachable, but its native event channel has remained disconnected. Doorbell notifications still use the official Ring integration when available. Check the Vistoda Ring app network access and logs.
